spec.decomposition: churn_alpha = mean(entrant fwd) - mean(exit fwd) = sum(r_e/n_e) - sum(r_x/n_x); a name's share of the era LEVEL is its transition share / transitions
spec.reads: no engine, no curve, no cost arm: decisions and churn only

control.note: the published MID face was burned off the same decision sets on the same panel; a non-zero diff means this re-read moved, not that the arm did

answers.reading: 9 of 30 measured LEVEL cells are a one-name artefact (one name carries >= 50% of the cell)

honest: descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict on the strategy, no prereg, no trial count, no ledger booking
the share is a share of an equal-weight mean of name reads, not of money: a name moved the READ by its forward return, which the engine never charged the book for
a one-name artefact is usually a corporate-action read (share split) or a single-day gap, not a strategy property -- the name and date are published so a reader can check which
the arm is the key, never a column: every cell names the universe that produced it, because E96 lost that label once already
